title: 🍏 Apple Unveils A20 Pro Chip.. An AI Leap on 2-Nanometer Tech!
body: 🍏 Apple Unveils A20 Pro Chip.. An AI Leap on 2-Nanometer Tech!

Apple has unveiled its new A20 Pro chip, which will power the iPhone 18 Pro phones — the company's first chip built on 2-nanometer technology, meaning its transistors are smaller and packed closer together, so it runs faster and uses less power.
The chip carries a six-core CPU with built-in neural accelerators, a seven-core GPU, and a dual 16-core Neural Engine — 32 neural cores in total, dedicated to AI tasks.
The company says the new chip's memory bandwidth is 50% higher than the A19 Pro's, graphics performance is up to 40% faster, and AI processing power has doubled compared to the previous generation.

In practice, that means the phone will be able to run larger AI models on the device itself without sending your data to the cloud, heavy games and video editing will run more smoothly, and the smart assistant will respond faster.

The announced figures come from the company itself and have not yet been verified by an independent party, and Apple has not revealed when the phones will launch or how much they will cost — but the new chip sketches the shape of the next generation of its flagship phones.
Simply put: a smaller, much more powerful chip that puts AI to work inside your phone, not on faraway servers.. Will your phone soon become a full smart computer in your pocket?
If your phone could run AI entirely offline, what is the first thing you would ask it to do?
